DaftCalculatorInputs.description:
The four quantitative inputs to the DAFT calculator method (SM 3).

The fifth calculator input, inheritance pattern, is the shared
``WorkflowParameters.moi`` and is not re-captured here.

allelic_heterogeneity.description: Fraction of disease alleles this variant could represent (0-1).
allelic_heterogeneity.title: Allelic Heterogeneity

locus_heterogeneity.description: Fraction of cases attributable to this locus (0-1).
locus_heterogeneity.title: Locus Heterogeneity

penetrance.description: Expected penetrance (0-1); use the lowest reasonable estimate.
penetrance.title: Penetrance

prevalence_denominator.description: X in a phenotype prevalence of '1 in X'; use the smallest reasonable X.
prevalence_denominator.title: Prevalence Denominator

DaftCalculatorInputs.title: DaftCalculatorInputs

DaftMethod.title: DaftMethod

TriState.description:
Tri-state truth value.

``TRUE``/``FALSE`` — the curator established the value. ``UNKNOWN`` —
the curator looked and could not determine it. A ``null`` field (absent)
means the value was **not captured at all**; ``UNKNOWN`` and ``null`` are
semantically distinct.
TriState.title: TriState

description:
Population-database frequency evidence for the VBC (POP_FRQ + POP_HMZ).

Permissive superset: every field is optional. The payload behind a
``population_frequency`` Evidence Item; a curation-level counterpart to the
VA-Spec Cohort Allele Frequency Study Result.

daft.description: Disease Allele Frequency Threshold: the MDE-specific ceiling the FAF is compared against.
daft.title: Daft

daft_calculator_inputs.description: The calculator method's inputs, when daft_method is CALCULATOR (optional, for reproducibility).

daft_method.description: How the DAFT was obtained/derived (see DaftMethod).

faf.description: Filtering Allele Frequency (population-max, lower-95%-CI-bound AF), e.g. from gnomAD.
faf.title: Faf

faf_source.description: Source/version of the FAF, e.g. 'gnomAD v4.1.1'.
faf_source.title: Faf Source

hemizygote_count.description: Number of hemizygous occurrences (X-linked) of the VBC.
hemizygote_count.title: Hemizygote Count

hmz_eligible.description: Whether the MDE's penetrance + severity make affected individuals implausible in the population database, so occurrences count as benignity evidence (SM 3, Table 7).

homozygote_count.description: Number of homozygous occurrences of the VBC in the population database.
homozygote_count.title: Homozygote Count

title: PopulationEvidence
